main_text.l: CXXVII. Non in splendore splendor famæ.

In gratiosa hominum recte sentientium memo-ria, non in fumosarum imaginum numerosa pompa, claritas bonorum virorum fundatur. Funus Juniæ vi-ginti clarissimarum familiarum imagines antelatę co-mitabantur. Cassii & Bruti ingrata dominantibus, vivens in civium animis imago, negligebatur. sed praefulgebant Cassius atque Brutus, eo ipso, quod effigies eorum non visebantur. Gratam igitur sui memoriam, & autoritatem post fata mansuram, paret[?]; de imaginum pompa securior; qui vivere adempta vita, qui clarescere in secutura secula desiderat.

page.notes: The marginal note "claritas" stands in the left margin beside the line "claritas bonorum"; it is set in italic. "paret" is printed as "parent" in the scan and was read as "paret" with a doubtful final letter; "parct;" may be the printed form. The ornament below the text is not transcribed. "QUARTUS" at the foot is treated as a catchword.
